bibliography.title: Eigenvectors of Experts are Training-free Non-collapsing Routers

page_map.boundary_rule: 正文结束于 p.9 §5；p.10 为 Impact Statement 后接 References；p.15 的 A. Supplementary Material 才开始附录。

abstract_sentences.text: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) architectures improve the training efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) by routing input tokens to a selected subset of specialized experts.
Despite their remarkable success, both training and inference in SMoE models suffer from the expert collapse issue (Chi et al., 2022), which degrades model performance.

evidence.anchor: suffer from the expert collapse issue

abstract_sentences.text: Prior studies primarily focus on improving the router; however, such methods rely on training from scratch or fine-tuning, which requires high computational and data-processing costs.
comparators: prior router methods versus training-free need

evidence.anchor: rely on training from scratch or fine-tuning

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore, we demonstrate that, despite these efforts, the issue persists when advancing well-pretrained SMoE models, as evidenced by both theoretical and empirical results.
comparators: prior improvement efforts versus persistent collapse

evidence.anchor: the issue persists when advancing well-pretrained SMoE models

abstract_sentences.text: To fill that gap, we analyze the advanced SMoE models and observe that the eigenvectors of expert weight matrices encode rich semantic information, pointing to an effective alternative to conventional routing strategies.

evidence.anchor: eigenvectors of expert weight matrices encode rich semantic information

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this insight, we propose Singular Value Decomposition SMoE (SSMoE), a novel and training-free framework that leverages spectral properties of the expert weights to address the collapse issue and enhance model performance.
Extensive experiments across diverse language and vision tasks, under both clean and corrupt data settings, demonstrate the strong generalization and robustness of SSMoE.

evidence.anchor: under both clean and corrupt data settings

abstract_sentences.text: Our findings highlight how a deeper understanding of model internals can guide the development of more effective SMoE architectures.

evidence.anchor: a deeper understanding of model internals

abstract_sentences.text: Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/giangdip2410/SSMoE.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 已训练 SMoE router 的 collapse 导向 expert-weight eigenvectors；SSMoE 把 EV 与 learned router 混合，再以 multi-domain performance、memory、corruption 与机制检查支撑其价值。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 研究问题/Finding callouts、Eq. (1)–(5)、Lemma 3.1、Figure 1–7、Table 1–6 和 retrieval bootstrap test 都留在正文，足以判断方法、平均收益和主要对照。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、Algorithm 1、硬件、dataset-level MTEB、fine-tuning、hash/random routing、flips/PPL/overlap 和 full-capacity GSM8K 分析在补充；复现与完整稳健性判断依赖补充。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Research Question → Finding callouts 建立问题—观察对应；Figure 2 同置 performance/memory；Table 5 做剥离式 EV selection ablation；Table 4 对小 gain 给 bootstrap evidence。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 条件性 pre-softmax correlation lemma 与实际 post-softmax selective mixture 的连接未用 ε/independence 的实测量闭合；多数结果缺 seed/repetition/uncertainty，pruning/GSM8K 解释后移附录。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 新表示改善选择机制的论文，应在正文并列可操作机制、最接近的剥离式 ablation、任务级不利结果与统计单位；平均收益和图示不能替代这些证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合跨模型/任务系统论文。只有机制被直接测量、关键不利结果可见、理论对象与实装对象相同，才可压缩证据；本篇没有同时满足这些条件。
